learning_objectives: Apply advanced prompting techniques like Chain-of-Thought, structured output, and iterative refinement to enhance AI responses.
outline: Structuring AI output with specific formats.

slides.title: Title Slide
slides.narration:
Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial.
It covers Advanced Prompting Techniques.
slides.image_prompt: Title slide with 'Advanced Prompting Techniques' as the main title, featuring abstract AI-themed graphics.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to apply advanced prompting techniques.
These include Chain-of-Thought.
You will also learn about structured output.
Finally, you will explore iterative refinement.
slides.image_prompt: Learning Objectives slide with bullet points for Chain-of-Thought, Structured Output, and Iterative Prompting.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration: Here, I am using a browser on a computer or mobile.
slides.image_prompt: System Requirements slide showing a generic web browser window on a laptop.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration: To follow this tutorial, you must be familiar with the basics of prompting.
slides.image_prompt: Prerequisites slide with text 'Familiarity with basic AI prompting'.

slides.title: Introduction to Advanced Prompting
slides.narration: We have learned about clear and concise prompts.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, looking thoughtful, with complex AI response on screen. Represents going beyond basic prompts.

slides.title: Chain-of-Thought (CoT)
slides.narration: First, let's explore Chain-of-Thought, or CoT.
slides.image_prompt: Graphic: 'Chain-of-Thought' title with gears and thought bubbles, 'Think Step-by-Step' highlighted.

slides.title: CoT - Example Problem
content: Prompt: "I have 5 boxes of apples. Each box has 12 apples. I eat 3 apples and give away one full box. How many apples are left?"
slides.narration: Let's try a math problem without CoT.
slides.image_prompt: ChatGPT interface, user typing the math problem prompt.

slides.title: CoT - Vague Output
slides.narration:
The AI tool might give a direct answer.
However, it might be incomplete or incorrect.
slides.image_prompt: ChatGPT response to the math problem, showing a single numerical answer or a slightly incorrect one.

slides.title: CoT - The Magic Phrase
slides.narration:
Now, let's add a special phrase.
This phrase helps the AI think.
slides.image_prompt: Highlighting the phrase 'Think step-by-step' being added to a prompt.

slides.title: CoT - Improved Prompt
content: Prompt: "I have 5 boxes of apples. Each box has 12 apples. I eat 3 apples and give away one full box. How many apples are left? Think step-by-step."
slides.narration:
Type this improved prompt into the AI tool.
Then, press enter to see the result.
slides.image_prompt: ChatGPT interface, user typing the improved math problem prompt with 'Think step-by-step'.

slides.title: CoT - Step-by-Step Output
slides.narration:
Observe the AI's response now.
Notice the detailed steps.
slides.image_prompt: ChatGPT response showing the step-by-step reasoning for the apple problem.

slides.title: Structuring Output
slides.narration: Next, let's learn to structure the AI's output.
slides.image_prompt: Graphic: Icons for different output formats (table, list, code, JSON) with a blueprint icon, symbolizing organization.

slides.title: Structuring Output - Markdown Table
content: Prompt: "List the pros and cons of remote work. Provide the output as a Markdown table with two columns: 'Pros' and 'Cons'."
slides.narration: Let's ask for pros and cons of remote work.
slides.image_prompt: ChatGPT interface, user typing the prompt for a Markdown table.

slides.title: Structured Output - Result
slides.narration: See how the AI provides a clean table.
slides.image_prompt: ChatGPT output showing the pros and cons of remote work in a Markdown table.

slides.title: Structuring Output - Other Formats
slides.narration:
You can ask for other formats too.
For example, try a numbered list or JSON.
slides.image_prompt: Examples of different output formats (numbered list, HTML snippet, JSON object, comma-separated list) on screen.

slides.title: Iterative Prompting
slides.narration: Finally, let's talk about Iterative Prompting.
slides.image_prompt: Two people conversing, with speech bubbles showing back-and-forth refinement, symbolizing iterative prompting.

slides.title: Iterative Prompting - First Attempt
content: User: "Write a slogan for my new coffee shop."
AI: "Brewing Happiness, One Cup at a Time."
slides.narration: Let's try to get a slogan for a coffee shop.
slides.image_prompt: ChatGPT interface, user typing the first slogan prompt and AI responding.

slides.title: Iterative Prompting - Refinement
content: User: "That's good, but can you make it shorter and more modern?"
slides.narration:
That's a good start.
However, we can improve it further.
slides.image_prompt: ChatGPT interface, user typing the follow-up prompt and AI responding with the refined slogan.

slides.title: Iterative Prompting - Perfect!
slides.narration:
This response is perfect!
It meets all our requirements.
slides.image_prompt: User smiling at the screen, showing the final refined slogan 'Urban Brews. Your Daily Grind.'.

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
With this, we come to the end of this tutorial.
Let us summarise the key points covered.
We learned about Chain-of-Thought for complex reasoning.
We explored structuring AI output into specific formats.
And we understood the power of iterative prompting to refine results.
slides.image_prompt: Summary slide with icons representing CoT, structured output, and iterative prompting.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
As an assignment, please do the following.
Find a complex problem online to solve.
Try solving it with an AI tool of your choice.
First, use a simple prompt for the problem.
Then, add "Think step-by-step" and compare the results.
Also, try asking the AI to summarize an article as a JSON object.
slides.image_prompt: Assignment slide, person working on a laptop, with text overlay of assignment instructions.
